screening_decisions.reason: Randomized controlled trial comparing thermoradiotherapy vs radiotherapy alone in rectal cancer. Patients were selected on the principle of randomization with 56 patients in intervention arm and 59 in control group.

Prospective randomized study comparing VHF+RT vs RT alone in rectal cancer. 75 patients randomized, 73 eligible for analysis.
